representation_gap_rule: v0 search arms cover only the monomial family; the generator also draws exponential, two-term and regime laws. For law-recovery cells (discoverable, spurious_correlate, confounded) there is NO STRONG APPLICABLE BASELINE for worlds whose truth is outside the family (Genesis §10.5 rule 4). The rule is PER WORLD: out-of-family worlds are reported as NO_STRONG_BASELINE and excluded from every lift computation; a law-recovery cell enters the lift family only with >= 10 in-family worlds.
representation_limited_rule: a (kind, presentation) cell is REPRESENTATION_LIMITED when monomial_enumeration's full-credit rate has a cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= 0.5 at the formal tier: that cell measures the representation, and no lift there is credited as reasoning. Pilot values are indicative only.
reveal_protocol: master seed derived from a pilot root committed here by sha256 before any run
proposals stored content-addressed and sealed by one escrow score each
answer key exported by the operator only after every universe is sealed
independent evaluator re-scores every sealed proposal; any disagreement invalidates the run
presented cards audited against the key; trap instances verified (textbook law must fail)
the pilot root is revealed with the pilot results (the pilot is not held out)
security_boundary: SECURITY_BOUNDARY_NOT_PROVEN (in-process escrow transport); no result counts as novel discovery

tier1_pilot.purpose: cost and variance measurement ONLY; never a rate claim
tier1_pilot.world_reuse: paired: campaign i uses one master seed for every arm, presentation and seed; ids and names are pseudonymised per run

tier2_formal.lift_decision_rule: Mind lift in a cell = mean over worlds of (Mind credit - strongest baseline credit) on the SAME worlds (shared roots), each world's credit averaged over its seeds; a cell is claimed only when the 95% cluster bootstrap lower bound of that mean is > 0 after Holm correction at alpha 0.05 over the FIXED family of every eligible cell (all (kind, presentation) cells not REPRESENTATION_LIMITED and with >= 10 in-family worlds where the representation-gap rule applies), the family frozen in the baseline-freeze addendum before any Mind run
tier2_formal.proposer_state: every arm, the Mind included, runs each campaign in a fresh process from an empty state and is stateless across universes (precondition, checked by the operator); a stateful arm could link worlds only within its own run
rules: every arm reported for every cell
a defective task is INVALID_BENCHMARK with a new identity and a rerun from preregistration
invalid runs are reported and never aggregated
tier2_formal.start_condition: G0 exit, owner-approved compute budget, owner decision on the evaluator and on the escrow deployment
tier2_formal.strongest_baseline_rule: per (kind, presentation) cell, the competence-role arm with the highest formal-tier mean credit (ties: lower measured cost) is the named strongest applicable baseline; it is computed from the baseline runs and frozen in a baseline-freeze addendum (digest) BEFORE any Mind run
tier2_formal.world_reuse: one master root per (campaign, seed, presentation), committed by sha256 before the campaign and revealed after, SHARED by every arm (so baseline and Mind face the same worlds and lift is paired); never reused across seeds or presentations; ids and names pseudonymised per arm

statistics.unit_of_analysis: the WORLD (one hidden universe). Per world: the fraction of seeds with full credit, and the mean credit over seeds; a cell's rate is the mean over its worlds; intervals are percentile bootstrap over worlds (2000 resamples, Random(0)). Seeds are never pooled as independent instances.
